You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

No one should have the possibility to pick up the morning-after pill over the counter at the pharmacy. Though there'd be the advantage of forgoing the embarrassment of a visit to the doctor or a nighttime trip to the walk-in clinic, women should still be informed about the risks and have a gynaecological examination before taking it. Furthermore there's the risk that women could use the over-the-counter morning-after pill as a substitute for contraception.
What argument components exists in sentence "No one should have the possibility to pick up the morning-after pill over the counter at the pharmacy" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.
<pro>No one should have the possibility to pick up the morning-after pill over the counter at the pharmacy</pro>
